[ASSISTANT_SAID] Increase the intensity by swimming at a faster pace or adding more intervals each week.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] **Phase 3: Endurance and Simulation (Weeks 9-12)**  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Frequency: 2-3 times a week, with at least one rest day in between.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Workout structure: Warm-up (5 minutes), swim 100-200 meters at a moderate pace (2-3 times), rest for 30-60 seconds between each swim, incorporate swim-bike-brick workouts: swim 200-400 meters, followed by 10-15 minutes of easy cycling or running (optional), cool-down (5 minutes).
